type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing A] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (α : σ → A) (r : σ → ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ A), (∀ j, MvPolynomial.degreeOf j P ≤ r j) → P = ∑ d ∈ Roth.box r, MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.eval α (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv d P)) * ∏ j, (MvPolynomial.X j - MvPolynomial.C (α j)) ^ d j
what: Reconstructs a polynomial from Hasse derivative values at a center as a finite sum of products of powers of X minus that center over a bounding coordinate box.
how: Coefficient extensionality and coeff_taylor identify translated coefficients; hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt kills out-of-box terms, and taylor_neg_taylor plus taylor_monomial transport back.
hypotheses: Arbitrary commutative coefficient ring, finite variable enumeration, arbitrary center and polynomial, natural coordinatewise degree bounds. Explicit DecidableEq can be removed using scoped Classical and propositional instance transport.
caller_summary: 1 explicit caller, eval_eq_sum_box at Taylor220; no direct callers outside file. Full evaluated caller checked both for original arbitrary DecidableEq and no-explicit-DecidableEq core. Main390 application is transitive through evaluated corollary.
mathlib_api_audit: Polynomial.sum_taylor_eq is univariate CommRing analogue. eval₂_eq supplies arbitrary-variable finite-support reconstruction, but not Hasse coefficient identification or off-box vanishing. Isolated successful support expansion verifies the boundary.
moral_duplications: Distinct coefficient, polynomial reconstruction and evaluation layers; same inverse-shift motif as univariate sum_taylor_eq but no direct specialization to multivariate Hasse box expansion.
generalization: Verified no explicit DecidableEq binder using open Classical in statement plus proof-local classical. Old arbitrary instance recovered by Subsingleton.elim and cases; propositional, not definitional transport. Fintype retained for full product and box. Raw arbitrary-variable support expansion is a different representation, not this same statement.
missing_api: Multivariate Hasse/Taylor coefficient-to-finite-box reconstruction; optional support-indexed intermediate using generic evaluation sums.
junk: Keep standard substantive reconstruction theorem; actual evaluated consumer feeds main Diophantine estimate.
action: YES-but-generalise-first: drop explicit equality-decision requirement with verified transport; propose Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial/Taylor.lean alongside coeff_taylor, using standard Finsupp interval infrastructure upstream. Production unchanged during survey.
